note: Hand-authored by the repository author together with the fixtures (never model-generated). Each list names the concepts a correct extraction of that fixture MUST find. Semantic-recall measurement compares normalized concept keys (normalizeConceptKey) with bidirectional containment, so 「间隔重复(Spaced repetition)」 matches the label 「间隔重复」. Raw concept COUNT is never the metric — recall against these labels is.
